result.reason: The operative revision reaches the preferred position by replacing Licensor’s unilateral seven-year renewal right with successive 12-month renewals requiring mutual written agreement and by capping renewal fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. It leaves unrelated termination rights unchanged and makes no unnecessary commercial changes. Drafting quality is reduced because Sections II and III redundantly address extensions, and Section II retains the malformed phrase “mutual written of the parties,” which should be corrected to “mutual written agreement of the parties.”
